title: Validate decimal code strings
body: parseCode currently converts arbitrary input using Number. Enforce the code format without changing successful conversion.
criteria: parseCode accepts only strings containing 1 to 4 ASCII decimal digits (0-9), including leading zeros, and returns their numeric value. It throws Error('Invalid code') for all other inputs, including non-strings, empty strings, signs, whitespace, decimal points, letters, and strings of 5 or more digits.
